methodology.features: Daily race cards and same-frame records from a Git commit before each published scheduled deadline; no previews, odds, current-season replacements or outcome-derived race features.
methodology.deadlineSource: Scheduled deadline field copied into historical results CSV; used only for the input-availability gate, never as a predictive feature.
methodology.popularity: Final winning trifecta popularity; post-outcome stratification only, never a feature or pre-race popularity estimate.
methodology.returnRate: Gross final payout / stake, 1000 yen per race. If any final payout is missing, full-cohort returnRate is null; knownPayoutReturnRate has its own explicit denominator.
methodology.exclusions: Only six distinct normal finishers, no F flag/negative ST. Abnormal/refunded/tied/unfinished results are excluded, not treated as losing bets.
methodology.comparison: Baseline uses unchanged application balance mode at 3/5/7/10 picks. Candidate learns first-place frame ratios on training only; alpha/temperature selected by validation log loss; final-test results never used for selection.
limitations: The source does not cover three full years.
Git committer times are historical evidence, not independent trusted timestamp certification.
Past planned deadlines are taken from archived results metadata; original schedule revisions cannot be independently reconstructed.
Baseline model prior tuning history is unknown, so the final-test partition is held out for this candidate experiment, not certified untouched by all prior baseline development.
Missing waku features remain missing; no later-date statistics are substituted.
No historical in-browser local-history collection is reproduced.
Final popularity groups are retrospective descriptions.
Exclusions and single chronological split can bias estimates; prospective validation is still required.

weaknesses: 最終テストの現行モデルlog lossは4.0844、候補は3.9289。候補はこの期間で確率誤差を低減。
展示・事前オッズ・実進入を復元しないため、ライブ予想の全特徴を再現した成績ではありません。
最終テストの1枠1着率は実際54.46%、現行モデルの平均予測31.60%。枠番の確率配分にずれがあります。
全期間の枠番情報欠損は5186レース。取得開始前の成績と取得後は入力条件が異なります。
場別・月別・人気別の成績には標本数の違いがあり、ランキングだけで優位性を断定できません。
回収率が100%を超えても、将来の収益や統計的な優位性を保証しません。
